The transfer function has a wrong logic in _transfer function, where it only checks balanceOf[_from] >= _value, allowing a user to transfer more tokens than it owned.
The transferFrom function has a wrong logic in _transfer function, where it only checks balanceOf[_from] >= _value, allowing a user to transfer more tokens than it owned.
The approve function has a typo in it, allowing attackers to exploit it during the migration process, causing unexpected token loss.
